# CATI E&M CMS

> Internal complaint management platform for the Civil Aviation Training Institute (CATI) Hyderabad — Electrical & Mechanical Section. Tracks facility complaints across locations with role-based dashboards for admins, technicians, and officials.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the CATI E&M CMS — features, workflow, and access roles.
- [Sign In](/auth): Secure sign-in for CATI staff. Public registration is disabled.
